title: Release Blocker Remediation

evidence.claim: Audit identified Python support, built-distribution validation and stale release metadata as release blockers R1-R3.
Linux matrix now validates Python 3.10-3.13, Windows-native validation remains, and package-smoke builds/installs the wheel and executes installed entrypoints.
README now describes current v1.0 release-closure state and implemented runtime/editorial capabilities.
Initial v0.2 import record is clearly marked historical provenance rather than current state.
Version synchronization, Python lower-bound declaration and README baseline are protected by regression tests.

remaining_release_blockers: R4 release governance: RC manifest/changelog, final v1.0 version lock, exact-head validation, explicit human approval before merge/tag/release
blockers: Current-head expanded CI must pass, including Python 3.10 and package-smoke, before 0075 can close.
next_action: Run checkpoint 0076 Release Candidate Preflight after expanded CI passes; immediately repair any Python 3.10 or packaging regression if CI fails.
